item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 13/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coastal areas of southern China in the next couple of days. Besides, the anticyclone aloft will weaken in the middle and latter parts of this week. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds will cover southern China. There will be one or two rain patches over the region.

Date/Month: 14/11 (Monday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Sunny intervals in the morning.
Temp range: 23 - 26 C
R.H. range: 75 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
